start: Owner signed in. 'Workout plans', '+ New plan', 'Start empty'

steps.action: Look at the sheet
user_sees: 'New workout plan'
'Members see it in the MettleUp app after one check-in at the gym.'
'Plan name' (cursor in it), 'Note for members (optional)'
'Days' with '+ Add day' and a chip 'Day 1 · 0 exercises'
'No exercises on this day yet. Search below to add one.'
must_not: A plan saved just by opening the sheet

steps.action: Type the plan name 'Beginner 3 days', a Day name, pick 'Kind of day'
user_sees: The chip shows the day name
must_not: The name cut without a word

steps.action: Type 'bench' under 'Add an exercise' and tap '+ <exercise>'
user_sees: The exercise box: '1. <name>', muscles and how it is logged, 'Sets (1-20)', 'Reps from', 'Reps to (max 100)', 'Start kg (optional)' with 'Empty: they choose', 'Rest (seconds)' with 'Empty: their own timer'
The search box is empty again
Chip 'Day 1 · 1 exercise'
must_not: '1 exercises'
The same exercise added twice by one tap

steps.action: Type Start kg 20; tap '+ Add day' and add an exercise there too
user_sees: Hint under Start kg 'Until they log their own'
A second chip, selected
must_not: A 15th day accepted
Day 1's exercises lost when switching days

steps.action: Under 'Send to', type a member's name and tick them
user_sees: The member with their mobile number and a pill 'Sending'
After clearing the search: '1 member ticked.'
must_not: A member of another gym in the search
More than 30 matches drawn at once

steps.action: Tap 'Save plan'
user_sees: 'Saving…'
Toast '“Beginner 3 days” saved and sent.'
The plan in the list with 'by <the user's name>'
must_not: Two plans from a double tap
The plan sent to anyone not ticked

start: Owner signed in, in the builder: the other kinds of 'who gets it' and of exercise

steps.action: Under 'Or everyone on a membership plan (who has it today)', tick a membership plan
user_sees: Pill 'Sending' on that plan; the line under 'Send to' names it
must_not: Members whose membership ended getting it
A plan that is 'No longer sold' offered unless it was already ticked

steps.action: Type an exercise name that is not in the list and tap '+ Add “<name>” as your own exercise'
user_sees: 'Your own exercise' and a box 'Main muscle' with 'Needed so the member’s app can add it'
must_not: The own exercise saved without a main muscle

steps.action: Pick a hold exercise from the list
user_sees: A 'Seconds (…)' box in place of reps and kg
must_not: Reps boxes for a timed hold

steps.action: Tap 'Save plan' with nobody ticked
user_sees: Toast '“<name>” saved. Tick members to send it.'
must_not: 'saved and sent' when it went to nobody

start: Owner signed in, in the builder with wrong input

steps.action: Tap 'Save plan' with no name
user_sees: 'Give the plan a name.'
must_not: A nameless plan saved

steps.action: Type a name of more than 80 letters and save
user_sees: 'Keep the plan name to 80 letters.'
must_not: The name cut silently

steps.action: Leave a day without exercises and save
user_sees: 'Add at least one exercise to <day>.'
must_not: An empty day sent to members

steps.action: Clear Sets, or type reps from 12 to 8, and save
user_sees: '<exercise>: sets must be a whole number from 1 to 20.' / '<exercise>: the lowest reps can’t be more than the highest.'
must_not: Bad numbers reaching a member's phone

steps.action: Add 14 days
user_sees: '+ Add day' and 'Copy day' greyed, 'A plan can have at most 14 days.'
must_not: A 15th day

steps.action: Add 30 exercises to one day
user_sees: 'A day can have at most 30 exercises.' in place of the search
must_not: A 31st exercise

start: Owner signed in, a saved plan opened with 'Edit'

steps.action: Tap 'Copy day', then 'Move day later ›', then 'Remove this day' on a day
user_sees: The chips change at once; the last day cannot be removed (no button)
must_not: Exercises of another day changed
A plan left with no day

steps.action: Tap 'Cancel'
user_sees: The list, plan unchanged
must_not: Any of the edits saved

steps.action: Open 'Edit' again, untick a member, tap 'Save changes'
user_sees: Toast '“<name>” updated.'
must_not: The routine removed from that member's phone (it stays; they get no more changes: unknown how the app shows it)

steps.action: Open 'Edit' while a second person saves the same plan, then tap 'Save changes'
user_sees: 'Someone else changed this plan while you had it open. Close it and open it again to see their changes.'
must_not: The other person's change lost
Both changes half-merged

start: Owner signed in, choosing who gets a plan

steps.action: Search under 'Send to'
user_sees: Members of this gym by name with their mobile numbers
must_not: Members of another gym or branch
The plan visible in the app of a member who is not ticked and not on a ticked membership plan

steps.action: Save the plan
user_sees: The maker's name is kept on the plan and shown to the gym's staff on the list
must_not: An injury or health word typed in a note shown to members other than those who get the plan
